how_to_use: Same engine as wave-build-guides.json. Each flow is a list of steps; show a step as an assistant message from Wave (typed ~45 chars/s, instant with reduced motion) and play its audio. 'advance_on' lists events separated by |: 'auto' shows the next step right after this one has played, 'next' is the Next button, 'end' is the last step. 'open_tab' (optional) shows an 'Open the <tab> tab' button that switches to that tab. 'learn_more' {label, steps} shows a Learn more button right of Skip guide that plays those steps, then returns. 'Guide me through this tab' plays the tab_<current tab> flow. Events: info_saved, cards_added, customize_saved, rules_saved, listing_saved, dry_run_done, publish_done, name_pointed. If an app can't see an event, the step also accepts next.

steps.text: Let's build your bot, one tab at a time. Want to know more first? Click Learn more.
Every Wave bot lives on the Theta blockchain: its name, rules, look and knowledge, all signed by you.
That means anyone can check it's the real bot, and nobody can quietly change it. Not even Wave.
Updates add a new version on chain. Old versions stay, marked replaced. You can replace, but never delete.
People can use your bot in Wave Web and Wave OS, and AI apps can ask it through Wave. Ready when you are.
Start with Info: give your bot a name, a short About, and a personality, the way it should talk.
Now Cards. These are what your bot knows. Add a migration with your notes, documents or a Maker recipe. One idea per card.
Customize is the fun part: pick a color, draw or import a mascot, and choose its animations.
In Rules, choose who can use it: public and free, paid per answer, or private for wallets you allow.
Listing is how people find it: a one-line pitch, a category and tags. Fill from cards can write a first draft.
Last stop, Publish. Try Test without minting first. It runs every check and shows the price, and nothing is signed.
When it's ready, click Publish. One button mints only what changed, points your name and checks it's live. You approve in your wallet.
Your bot is live on Theta! Share its link, or submit it to the bots.theta store from the Publish tab.
Let's put your bot on Theta. Want to know what publishing does? Click Learn more.
Publishing mints your bot's cards to Theta: its look, rules and knowledge, plus a listing that ties them together.
Only what changed gets minted, so updates cost less than the first publish. You see the total in TFUEL before you approve.
Wave Wallet Mint signs with your own wallet. Your keys never leave it, and private cards are encrypted there first.
Then your .theta name points to the new version, so everyone gets the latest. Ready when you are.
First, Test without minting. It runs every check and shows the price, and nothing is signed.
Fix any amber rows. Everything green? Then click Publish and approve in your wallet.
No .theta name yet? Prove you own one, or request a free bots.theta name. Wave reviews every request.
Done! To show it in the store, submit it to the curator. Once approved, it appears in bots.theta.
Info is your bot's identity: name, About and personality. The personality is how it talks, not what it knows. Save when you're done.
Cards are your bot's knowledge, one idea per card. Add a migration to bring in notes or a recipe. Public cards anyone can read; private cards are encrypted in Wave Wallet Mint.
Customize sets the look: color, mascot and animations. Your mascot is minted with your bot, so it's the same everywhere.
Rules decide who can use your bot: public and free, paid per answer, or private for wallets and names you allow. They're minted as your bot's rules card when you publish.
Listing is your store page: a one-line pitch, a category and tags. It's optional. Unlisted bots still work by name and link.
Publish does everything in one go: it checks your bot, mints only what changed, points your name and confirms it's live. Try Test without minting first.
